request.deadline: 52-week contract period, with architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including cardano-node and cardano-wallet integration, hard fork readiness, dependency updates, release engineering, and platform support
Compatible Daedalus stable release at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support plus newer hardware wallet models as they emerge
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation in Daedalus with documentation and dApp interoperability verification
Ongoing user support including Japanese-language support and full Japanese translation across shipped features
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. with Intersect serving as administrator and milestone verifier
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc. as a time and materials treasury-funded engagement.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, running an embedded Cardano node and deriving wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus private keys are generated and stored on the user's device and are never transmitted to an external service, with source code auditability under the Apache License 2.0.
Opt-in telemetry shows approximately 4,000 monthly active Daedalus users, while the proposer asserts the true count is meaningfully higher because privacy-conscious users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, native Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The proposal commits to keeping Daedalus compatible with upcoming hard forks and shipping a stable compatible release at least two weeks before each mainnet activation.
The proposal includes ecosystem expansion through Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, a CIP-30 dApp connector, Japanese localisation, and user support.
All release-timing and version-currency success metrics are described as independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The requested withdrawal is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Intersect is responsible for administration, milestone verification, monthly disbursements against verified work, and holding treasury funds in a dedicated account auditable by the Cardano Community.

The total 1,785,333 ADA budget consists of 1,666,667 ADA for team labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee, with unspent labor, hardware, and audit funds returned to the treasury.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for Se7en Labs to maintain and improve Daedalus over roughly one contract year, with Intersect administering milestone-based monthly disbursements and public-good outputs including protocol maintenance, releases, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, support, and an architecture assessment.
